info.title: Duhn implemented management API
info.description: Implemented application routes only. Same-origin session cookie issued by Better Auth at /api/auth; public signup disabled. Receiving, reversal, factory configuration, direct raw-to-oil linking, direct production start, and oven start are implemented. Oven completion, filtering, packing, final stock, quantity-only sale and oven pause/resume are implemented. In-app notifications are available; external delivery is not implemented. Reports are server-rendered. Production commands currently require owner/manager; operator delegation is pending.
